answer: Probe identities for bounded operator attention: at unpredictable moments each identity must answer a fresh interactive challenge within seconds — unpre-scriptable, too fast for one mind piloting a thousand seats. The network tends its garden by hand, walking every row while probes roll in; a ripple of missed answers marks clones the lone operator could not water in time. Missing probes throttles emissions. A sybil farmer's seats collapse to what one person's reflexes can tend from a single jetty: one human, one effective identity — farming stops paying.
